newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes weaker against dlr.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes weaker against dlr.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed easier at 43.7500/7800 to the dollar in interbank trading on Tuesday as U.S. dollar demand remained strong, dealers said.

"Many banks, especially the small ones, have been crowding the interbank market for dollars since the central bank tightened its own selling. But major dollar selling banks are failing to respond," said one dealer.
Interbank call money rates closed at 5.5 to 6.5 against six to 6.50 percent previously, dealers said.
